item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. You've got a full day ahead — errands, some movement, family time, and a check-in with yourself tonight. It's easy to let water slide when you're bouncing between tasks all day. Dehydration hits your focus and your mood before you even notice it's happening. So here's the action: fill a bottle right now, keep it in sight, and finish it before your evening wind-down starts.
